# Dakly

> Zero-Setup Headless Transactional Email & OTP Delivery Engine for Developers. Turn free Gmail accounts into production-grade transactional SMTP relays with multi-account failover, progressive Smart Warm-up, custom sender aliases, and real-time open/click telemetry.

## Overview
Dakly solves the high cost and strict domain verification roadblocks of traditional transactional email providers (e.g., Resend, SendGrid, Postmark) by enabling developers to securely leverage free Gmail and Google Workspace accounts with zero credit cards, zero domain DNS setup, and zero monthly subscriptions.

- **Website**: https://dakly.cc.cd
- **Live Engine API**: https://dakly-engin.vercel.app
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/parthpatil1234p-svg/Dakly
- **License**: MIT
- **Pricing**: 100% Free & Open Source

## Key Architectural Capabilities

### 1. Multi-Gmail Failover Pool
- Connect multiple Gmail accounts to a single project.
- Automatic failover: When primary account hits Google's 500 emails/day quota or rate limit, Dakly seamlessly routes outgoing emails to backup accounts in real time.
- Zero message loss or downtime.

### 2. Progressive Smart Warm-up & Rate Pacing
- Safeguards fresh Gmail accounts from spam filters.
- Automatically paces delivery from 20 emails/day up to full volume over 14 days.
- Leaky-bucket pacing queue prevents burst-sending spikes.

### 3. Custom Gmail Sender Aliases
- Send dynamically using aliases configured in your Google account (e.g., `support@yourdomain.com`, `billing@yourdomain.com`).
- Dakly detects aliases automatically and routes to the owning Gmail account.

### 4. Real-time Telemetry & Webhooks
- Cryptographically signed 1x1 transparent tracking pixel for Open Rates.
- Signed redirection proxy for Click-Through Rates (CTR).
- Instant HMAC-SHA256 authenticated webhooks for `email.sent`, `email.delivered`, `email.opened`, `email.clicked`, and `email.bounced`.

### 5. Automatic Bounce Guard & Suppression
- Hard bounces (550 Mailbox Not Found) are automatically recorded to a project suppression list.
- Future sends to suppressed addresses are rejected instantly (`BLOCKED_SUPPRESSED`) before hitting Google servers, protecting your sender reputation.

### 6. Military-Grade Credential Security
- Google App Passwords are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM with unique cryptographic initialization vectors (IV) and authentication tags.
- Multi-tenant isolation, IP whitelisting with CIDR subnet support, and instant API key rotation.

## Quickstart Guide

### Node.js SDK Installation
```bash
npm install @dakly/sdk
```

### Sending an Email (Node.js)
```javascript
import { Dakly } from '@dakly/sdk';

const dakly = new Dakly('gkey_live_your_api_key_here');

// Send high-priority OTP
const result = await dakly.sendOtp({
  to: 'user@example.com',
  otp: '849204',
  expiresInMinutes: 10,
});

console.log('Email sent:', result.id, 'via sender:', result.sender);
```

### Sending with Custom Sender Alias & Template
```javascript
const result = await dakly.send({
  to: 'client@company.com',
  fromAlias: 'billing@myagency.com',
  subject: 'Your Invoice #1042',
  template: 'invoice',
  templateVars: {
    customerName: 'Alice Johnson',
    amount: '$149.00',
    invoiceNumber: 'INV-1042',
    paymentLink: 'https://pay.example.com/inv-1042'
  }
});
```

### Direct REST API (cURL)
```bash
curl -X POST "https://dakly-engin.vercel.app/api/send" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-api-key: gkey_live_your_api_key_here" \
  -d '{
    "to": "user@example.com",
    "subject": "Welcome to our platform!",
    "html": "<h1>Hello World!</h1><p>Sent for free via Dakly.</p>"
  }'
```

## Comparison: Dakly vs Traditional Email Providers
| Feature | Dakly | Resend | SendGrid | Raw Nodemailer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Cost** | 100% Free | Paid tiers ($20+/mo) | Paid tiers ($19.95+/mo) | Free (manual setup) |
| **Domain Setup** | Zero setup required | Requires DNS DKIM/SPF | Requires DNS records | Manual setup |
| **Failover Pool** | Automated multi-Gmail pool | No (single domain) | No | None (crashes on 500) |
| **Sender Aliases** | Native dynamic detection | Domain-only | Domain-only | Manual config |
| **Smart Warmup** | Automated 14-day schedule | Manual | Add-on feature | None |
| **Open/Click Tracking** | Built-in telemetry & webhooks | Built-in | Built-in | Requires custom server |
| **Bounce Guard** | Automatic suppression list | Built-in | Built-in | None |
